claims.claim_text: The indexed Odd A. Anderson is confirmed as the Purdue student and enlisted OSS NORSO member who served on Operation Rype.
claims.evidence_excerpt: The NORSO I personnel dropped onto Lake Jaevsjo were: T/3 Odd A. Anderson
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Bolland's Operation Rype roster supplies the exact name, middle initial, grade, and a private service identifier that matches the NARA index; contemporary Purdue records and a later interview add consistent biographical details.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed: the uncommon exact name and middle initial, matching private service identifier, compatible enlisted grade, Purdue affiliation, and explicit OSS Operation Rype service converge on one person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Operation Rype roster documents OSS NORSO service in 1945; the Purdue sources document the same uncommon name in 1941-42.
claims.match_notes: The public profile states that the private identifier matches but never publishes the number. The NARA index prints Sgt while the operation roster prints T/3; the unique identifier resolves the otherwise compatible grade variation.
